definitions.explanation: A type of fungus that grows in damp conditions, appearing as fuzzy patches on food, walls, or other surfaces.

examples.japanese: パンにカビが{生|は}えた。
{浴室|よくしつ}のカビを{取|と}る。
examples.english: I remove the mold in the bathroom.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}の{時期|じき}はカビが{発生|はっせい}しやすい。
examples.english: Mold tends to grow during the rainy season.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in katakana (カビ), but can also be written as {黴|かび}.

VERB PATTERNS:
・カビが{生|は}える - mold grows
・カビが{発生|はっせい}する - mold occurs
・カビを{取|と}る - to remove mold
・カビが{付|つ}く - mold forms (on something)

TYPES:
・{黒|くろ}カビ - black mold
・{白|しろ}カビ - white mold
・{青|あお}カビ - blue mold (including penicillium)

COLLOCATIONS:
・カビ{臭|くさ}い - moldy, musty (smell)
・カビ{防止|ぼうし} - mold prevention
・カビ{取|と}り - mold removal
・カビ{取|と}り{剤|ざい} - mold remover

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's humid climate, especially during {梅雨|つゆ} (rainy season), makes mold prevention a common household concern.
